priority_items.title: Gavoka says Fiji HIV emergency should not deter visitors; FCOSS asks for resource priority
priority_items.summary: In-window RNZ pubDate 23:10:57 UTC: Tourism Minister/DPM Viliame Gavoka says Fiji is 'very open' about the HIV crisis and that ANZ-origin visitors should not be deterred. FCOSS CEO Vani Catanasiga says public statements are not enough and that the constitutional clock is crowding HIV resources. Overlay: ABC recap published 23:45:05Z restates 1-in-60 / 2,016 / 27%. Gazette still missing. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: UN Special Rapporteur concludes first official RMI visit (nuclear + climate)
priority_items.summary: In-window PINA datePublished 23:22:08 UTC: Andrea Bolaños Vargas concludes a first official country visit to the Marshall Islands (Majuro/Kwajalein from 7 Sep). Links US nuclear-testing legacy and sea-level rise to pressure on rights defenders; calls on the United States for truth, justice and reparation; full report to HRC March 2027. Overlaps WIM ExCom 25. Not a Compact amendment. Not FLASH.
